verdict.rationale: Publishing third-party authorization rules is a fair question for a state business-filing agency, so the axis applies. However, the pack contains no published authorization forms, delegate role definitions, or rules on which signatures must stay personal. The only related item is a passing note about 'Filing Administrator functions' in the Ohio Business Gateway, which names a role but publishes nothing about what a third party may or may not do. The SOS's own sites (ohiosos.gov, bsportal) were not readable beyond robots.txt, so no SOS delegation documentation was observed.
